raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An RL weight sync runs `pause_generation` in retract mode, then `update_weights_*` with `flush_cache=True`, then `continue_generation`. The flush queues AllBlocksCleared, but a paused scheduler never publishes KV events, so a KV-event router (sgl-router, or Dynamo) keeps that worker's whole pre-flush cache view for the entire sync and scores requests against blocks that no longer exist. The clear reaches the router only after resume.

#24003 added a publish at pause entry. It covers what was queued up to the pause, not what happens during it, such as the weight update's flush.

Found while following #24003's pause-time flush through a weight update.

## Modifications

Every pausable event loop (normal, overlap, PD prefill, PD decode, MLX) calls `_record_scheduler_state_for_paused_engine()` on each paused iteration and skips `on_idle`. This adds one `publish_kv_events()` call to that helper, which covers the flush and anything else recorded while paused. The call does nothing on ranks without a publisher, and on an idle paused loop it only drains an empty queue.

## Accuracy Tests

In `test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_pause_generation.py`:

- New case with a real RadixCache and publisher: pause (retract), flush_cache, one paused iteration, then AllBlocksCleared must have been published.

Results:

- main: `Lists differ: [] != ['AllBlocksCleared']`
- this PR: the file passes (29 passed)

CPU only, stub scheduler, Python tree core. I have not run it against a live router or an RL job.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #46258 (every decode step publishes; this PR covers the paused loop). #46307 edits the same paused-loop branch for a different reason; the two changes are independent.

Developed with AI assistance (Claude); every changed line was reviewed and the tests were run locally by me.

files.patch:
@@ -5727,6 +5727,9 @@ def _record_scheduler_state_for_paused_engine(self) -> None:
             self.metrics_reporter.record_scheduler_idle()
         else:
             self.metrics_reporter.record_scheduler_active(time.monotonic_ns())
+        # Paused loops skip on_idle; publish here so a pause-time flush_cache
+        # (weight update) reaches KV-event routers before resume.
+        self.kv_events_publisher.publish_kv_events()
 
     def is_fully_idle(self, for_health_check=False, ignore_waiting=False) -> bool:
         # Health check piggybacks on running requests in process_output.

@@ -24,8 +24,12 @@
 )
 from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req, ScheduleBatch
 from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.kv_events_publisher import (
+    SchedulerKvEventsPublisher,
+)
 from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.pool_stats_observer import PoolStats
 from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.running_reqs import RunningReqs
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.radix_cache import RadixCache
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, publish, reset_context
 from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
@@ -308,6 +312,43 @@ def test_inplace_only_sets_flag(self):
         self.assertIs(scheduler.cur_batch_for_debug, original_cur_batch)
         self.assertIs(scheduler.chunked_req, original_chunked_req)
 
+    def test_cache_flush_while_paused_is_published_before_resume(self):
+        """A cache flush during a retract pause (the weight-update window) must be
+        published by the paused loop, not held until continue_generation."""
+        scheduler = self._new_scheduler()
+        scheduler.tree_cache = RadixCache.create_simulated(enable_kv_cache_events=True)
+        scheduler.tree_cache.take_events()  # Drop the construction-time clear.
+        published = []
+        scheduler.kv_events_publisher = SchedulerKvEventsPublisher(
+            kv_events_config=None,
+            tree_cache=scheduler.tree_cache,
+            send_metrics_from_scheduler=None,
+            max_running_requests=1,
+            max_total_num_tokens=1,
+            get_stats=lambda: None,
+        )
+        scheduler.kv_events_publisher.enable_kv_cache_events = True
+        scheduler.kv_events_publisher.kv_event_publisher = SimpleNamespace(
+            publish=published.append
+        )
+        scheduler.grammar_manager = MagicMock(grammar_queue=[])
+        scheduler.dllm_manager = MagicMock()
+        scheduler.dllm_manager.any_staging_reqs.return_value = False
+        scheduler.enable_hisparse = False
+        scheduler.enable_hierarchical_cache = False
+        scheduler.enable_lmcache = False
+        scheduler.draft_worker = None
+
+        scheduler.pause_generation(PauseGenerationReqInput(mode="retract"))
+        self.assertTrue(scheduler.flush_cache(empty_cache=False))
+        scheduler._record_scheduler_state_for_paused_engine()
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [type(e).__name__ for batch in published for e in batch.events],
+            ["AllBlocksCleared"],
+            "flush_cache while paused was not published by the paused loop",
+        )
+
     def test_inplace_does_not_drain_overlap_queue(self):
         """in_place should not process the overlap result_queue."""
         scheduler = self._new_scheduler()
